nodes.label: Internal team shipment workflow
nodes.rationale: ## How work moves between teams - **Intake:** select the billing customer, shipment date, and route; upload an order; verify the detected shops, products, pack sizes, and quantities.

nodes.label: Handoff 01
nodes.rationale: | Procurement | Consolidate demand and confirm actual purchases | Confirmed purchase batch and Handoff 01 | | Packing | Automatically prepare boxes, adjust contents, bulk-save weights, and finalize | Locked final pack and Handoff 02 | | Scan sticker | Open an order using its box sticker | Editable packing view or finalized record | | Billing | Review invoices and record cleared payments | Final invoice, balance, and receipt |

nodes.label: Handoff 02
nodes.rationale: | Packing | Automatically prepare boxes, adjust contents, bulk-save weights, and finalize | Locked final pack and Handoff 02 | | Scan sticker | Open an order using its box sticker | Editable packing view or finalized record | | Billing | Review invoices and record cleared payments | Final invoice, balance, and receipt | | Users | Create accounts and manage access | Active users with appropriate permissions |

nodes.label: Finalized-packing invoicing
nodes.rationale: - Billing uses returned final packing rather than the original estimated order. - Payment amounts cannot exceed the outstanding balance. - Account permissions determine available pages and actions.

nodes.label: Master invoice
nodes.rationale: | Master invoice | One invoice combining eligible sub-orders | | Client acknowledgment | A receipt of an uploaded order; it is separate from a payment receipt | ## Controls users encounter

nodes.label: Historical settlement scope
nodes.rationale: - **Settlement:** accounting records partial or full cleared payments. Full settlement can issue a receipt when the required legal customer data is present. ## Important records and terms

nodes.label: Product and pack identity
nodes.rationale: saved products, pack counts and item weights. - **Finalization:** staff finalize the reviewed pack; box totals are derived from item weights plus the existing 0.5 kg packaging allowance per box. Locking and Handoff 02 complete together, making the order available for billing.

nodes.label: Human-reviewed Excel and PDF intake
nodes.rationale: not supported; enter those orders manually. All extracted results need human review. - Customer acknowledgment reports are viewed and downloaded within the platform. - Floor weights are entered manually in the current portal. Automatic Bluetooth scale capture and offline synchronization are outside these instructions.
